Composer: new words and new look

Datasec Security Composer · review pack for Kam · 12 October 2026

  • What changed: three merged pieces of work. One new sentence a salesperson can see (B125), five small look fixes on the details screens (B126), and a fix to the exception table on tablets (B129).
  • Checked: all three passed their QA gates (B128, B127 and B130 each said "GO WITH NOTES"). B127 found one Minor problem on tablets; B129 is the fix for it, and its gate B130 found no Blocker, Major or Minor.
  • Not on the demo yet: nothing here has gone to the demo.
  • Your tap: (a) approve, and Friday puts them on the demo; (b) approve with changes, written in a note; (c) hold.

1. B125: a new message when someone submits too early

If a salesperson clicks Submit for review while a critical issue is still open, the Approval screen (S9) now refuses and shows a box headed:

This cannot be done in the engagement's current state

with this new sentence under it. With one issue open:

Resolve every critical issue before submitting for review: 1 is still open, and Validation lists it.

With more than one (N is the number):

Resolve every critical issue before submitting for review: N are still open, and Validation lists them.
One thing to decide. "Validation lists them" is only true once someone has run a validation. On a version that has never been validated (like the one in the screenshot), the Validation screen has nothing yet; the issues show on Controls & policy instead. The builder suggested this alternative ending instead:
Generate lists them on Controls & policy
Your choice: keep "Validation lists them", or switch to the alternative (choose option b and say so in the note).

Also in B125: plus 7 technical sentences in the API description that users do not see. (The brief said 6; B125's own list has 7 contract-only rows.)

2. B126: details screens polish

One new sentence, on the Discovery screen:

Answers stored for a device group that is out of scope. They are kept, and not used while the group is out of scope; they cannot be changed here. Remove one to take it out of the engagement.

This sentence only appears for a question type that none of the current content uses. Nobody on the demo will see it today.

Offered by the builder but not built (your call, only if you want it): "This engagement is pinned to a content release the service no longer runs, so its policy cannot be chosen here." Without it, the screen in L1 simply shows no button.

Five look changes. All shots are Mac Chrome, made-up test data.

3. B129: exception table on tablets (601 to 900 px wide)

No new words. Only column widths changed. Across every tablet width from 601 to 900 px, no word breaks mid-word that did not already break on the demo build, and no button spills out of its cell (the demo build had up to 69 things outside their cells at 601 px). Fewer words break overall; some long words still break, as they did before.
